task1.title: Average percentages of sodium, saturated fats and added sugars in typical meals consumed in the USA
task1.prompt: The charts below show the average percentages in typical meals of three types of nutrients, all of which may be unhealthy if eaten too much.

chartDesc.title: Average percentages of sodium, saturated fats and added sugars in typical meals consumed in the USA
chartDesc.yAxis: Percentage of total daily nutrient intake (%)
chartDesc.overview: Dinner accounts for the highest proportion of both sodium (43%) and saturated fat (37%), whereas snacks comprise the largest share of added sugar (42%). Breakfast contributes the lowest percentage of nutrients overall.
keyFeatures: Sodium intake is highest during dinner at 43%, followed by lunch at 29%, with breakfast and snacks equal at 14% each.
Saturated fat is mostly consumed at dinner (37%) and lunch (26%), with snacks at 21% and breakfast lowest at 16%.
Added sugar consumption is dominated by snacks at 42%, while dinner accounts for 23%, lunch 19%, and breakfast 16%.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task2.title: Accepting or improving a bad situation
task2.prompt:
Some people believe that it is best to accept a bad situation, such as an unsatisfactory job or shortage of money. Others argue that it is better to try and improve such situations.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
